chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, he said: Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام said:
The maintenance of a pregnant woman whose husband has died is from the entirety of the wealth until she gives birth.

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakuni, the narrator through whom this report is transmitted
key_terms.الْمُتَوَفَّى: the one whose husband has died
key_terms.جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ: the entirety of the estate or wealth

ai.seo_question: From where is the maintenance of a pregnant woman whose husband has died to be paid?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the maintenance of a pregnant widow. It states that her expenses are to be provided from the full estate until the time she gives birth, indicating financial protection for her during pregnancy.
